title: Stochastic individual-bases models
summary: These are lecture notes for an advanced topics course in the master's programme at Bonn University. It aims to give a concise review of some of the work that has been done around the topic of adaptive dynamics from a rigorous stochastic point of view over the last 25 years and to make this area accessible to students with a good knowledge of probability in general, and the theory of Markov processes in particular.
